decision_table.name: Determine_AZ_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Arizona state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in AZ (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets AZ economic nexus threshold ($100,000 gross receipts)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Arizona filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Physical presence creates nexus under traditional standards and requires filing Arizona Form 120 (Corporation Income Tax Return).
Reference: AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1102 (Definitions and nexus standards) Reference: Arizona Department of Revenue, Transaction Privilege Tax Ruling TPR 95-24

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Arizona filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair).
Economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in gross receipts from Arizona customers in current or prior calendar year.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1102 (Economic nexus provisions) Reference: Arizona Department of Revenue, TPT 20-1 (Economic Nexus Guidance)
No Arizona nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_AZ_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Arizona state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Arizona state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Common additions to federal taxable income: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A deduction (if state doesn't conform) - Bonus depreciation (if state decouples from federal) - Other federal deductions Arizona doesn't allow
Common subtractions from federal taxable income: - Interest on Arizona municipal bonds - State income taxes (not deductible for state purposes) - Arizona net operating loss deduction - Other Arizona-specific deductions
Reference: Arizona Form 120, Schedule A (Adjustments to Income) Reference: AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1121 (Additions to Arizona gross income) Reference: AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1122 (Subtractions from Arizona gross income)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_AZ_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Arizona state corporate income tax. Applies 4.9% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Arizona state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Arizona: × [Apportionment percentage] 3. State additions: + [Additions from Schedule A] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions from Schedule A] 5. Arizona taxable income: = [Result] 6. Arizona tax rate: × 4.9% (flat rate) 7. Arizona income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Arizona credits: - [Credits] 9. Arizona tax liability: = [Final tax]
Arizona uses a flat 4.9% corporate income tax rate. Note: Rate scheduled to decrease to 2.5% by 2025 under HB 2900 (2021).
Available credits include: - Research and development credit - Renewable energy credits - Employment credits - Film production credit - Agricultural pollution control credit
Reference: Arizona Form 120 Instructions Reference: AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1111 (Tax rate: 4.9%) Reference: AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1139 (Apportionment: single-sales factor) Reference: Arizona Department of Revenue Publication 710 (Corporate Income Tax)
No Arizona nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.

No Arizona taxable income - no tax liability.
Arizona net operating loss (NOL) rules apply: - NOL carryforward: 20 years (conforms to federal) - NOL carryback: Not allowed (Arizona doesn't allow carrybacks)
Reference: AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1122(6) (NOL deduction)
